# Vendored Omarchy

Upstream: https://github.com/omacom/omarchy
Revision: 8675600e9ea0c6b6011de378b0625172b9cfdd46
Version: 4.0.0.alpha
Imported: 2026-09-18T22:21:43Z

`shell/`, `config/`, `default/` and `themes/` are upstream files, unmodified.
Theme backgrounds are left out of the vendored copy; OmarchyOS ships phone
wallpapers separately. Everything here stays byte-identical to upstream so the
shell can be re-synced with a single rsync.
